requirements.evidence: Code cannot load: app/Models/User.php:31 removes the opening '{' of casts(); app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:30 puts 'use Illuminate\Auth\Gate;' inside the class body (a trait use of a non-trait) and calls Gate::policy inside the Password::defaults closure; app/Models/EntityMembership.php:5 imports non-existent 'Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\HasFactory', and Entity.php:5 imports 'Attributes\SoftDeletes'. Factories have no 'namespace Database\Factories' and no employee() state. Migration uses generatedAs() (identity) instead of storedAs() for owner_seq (memberships migration:22). The current_entity alias is never registered; the navbar switcher link is missing; there is no slug-collision retry in submit(); /home does a findOrFail instead of the 0/1/>1 dispatch; the switcher view uses undefined $entity in route('entity.pick', $entity) (switcher.blade.php:3).

conventions.evidence: No app/Actions class for entity creation; CreateEntity validates inline ($this->validate([...]) at CreateEntity.php:22) instead of #[Validate]; no authorize() call; pick logic as a route closure in routes/web.php:63-71; migrations are hand-written; Entity.php:11-12 sets both #[Fillable] and $fillable; the onboarding form has no Bulma classes or accessible label binding; Dashboard text is hard-coded English ('Dashboard for entity'); no CHANGELOG update.

security.evidence: Dashboard.php has no authorize('view', $entity), and CurrentEntity.php:30-34 only checks membership of the session entity, so a user with a valid session for entity A can open /e/{B} and see B (the task requires 403). Policies compare the enum-cast role to strings (EntityPolicy.php:27 in_array($membership->role, ['owner','admin']); EntityMembershipPolicy.php:36 $membership->role === 'owner'), so the owner-delete guard never fires. The owner membership is deletable by admins because only self-deletion of the owner is blocked. CreateEntity::submit has no rate limit or authorize.

tests.evidence: The diff has no test files: no Pest tests for policies, middleware, onboarding, switcher, pick or dashboard, and no unauthorized-call or tamper tests for the Livewire actions.

simplicity.evidence: The code is small, but it has unused imports (CurrentEntity.php:7-13 Log/Gate/Route/Auth/DB; CreateEntity.php:11,13 Route, Validate), a duplicated fillable declaration (Entity.php:11-12) and a duplicated route import in routes/web.php (CreateEntity/Dashboard imported but referenced by FQCN).

issues.explanation: The opening brace of casts() was removed, which is a PHP parse error, so the whole application fails to boot.
'use Illuminate\Auth\Gate;' sits inside the class body (fatal error), the Gate facade is not imported, and the policies are registered inside the Password::defaults closure.
HasFactory and SoftDeletes are imported from the non-existent Eloquent\Attributes namespace, so the models fatal when they load.
No membership check against the requested entity: a user whose session points at entity A can view any other entity's dashboard by slug, which the task explicitly requires to return 403.
No tests at all, which violates the project's mandatory TDD rule and the Livewire unauthorized/tamper test requirement.
role is cast to the UserRole enum but compared to the strings 'owner'/'admin', so update/delete/assignRole/manageSettings always deny and the owner-membership delete guard never applies.
The owner's membership should never be deletable, but only self-deletion by the owner is blocked, so an admin could delete it.
generatedAs() creates an identity column, not a stored generated column; storedAs() is needed for the portable one-owner constraint.
There is no retry when a concurrent insert collides on the slug's unique index, which the task explicitly requires.
/home relies on the middleware and findOrFail, and the current_entity alias is never registered; the routes use the class name instead.
The form action uses $entity before it is defined (an undefined-variable error) and posts every button to one form instead of one POST form per entity.
The navbar link to entity.switcher for users with more than one membership was not implemented.
The factories lack the Database\Factories namespace, so Model::factory() cannot resolve them; the employee() state is missing and the slug is not guaranteed unique.
The domain write is not in an app/Actions class, there is no $this->authorize('create', Entity::class), and it uses inline validate() rules instead of #[Validate].
The form has no Bulma field/control/input classes and the label is not tied to the input (accessibility).
Hard-coded English text, while all screen text must come from lang/*/ui.php.
Leftover placeholder comments ('// Existing code...') and unused imports.
Removes existing ER diagram fields unrelated to the task; no CHANGELOG entry.

review.summary: The change sketches the entity models, policies, migrations, the middleware and the Livewire pages, but several PHP fatal/parse errors (User::casts brace, a 'use' inside the AppServiceProvider class, wrong trait namespaces) mean the app cannot boot. The dashboard lacks a per-entity authorization check, the policies compare enum roles to strings, several requirements are missing (slug-collision retry, navbar link, middleware alias, a working switcher), and there are no tests. Reject.
